answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Proof of unique pool pump runtime log changes that arithmetic: a pump running on one timer for three summers, so the oasis for each fake is paid in the real world. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while a pump running on one timer for three summers takes days to arrange for each new name; the jetty is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the summit of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
